statement: Pinned Dolphin source headers specify Nunchuk six-byte stick/ten-bit acceleration/active-low buttons, Classic six-byte bit packing and MotionPlus14-bit gyro/slow/downstream flags. MotionPlus.cpp651-710 describes pass-through bit relocation. Its base extension register is21 controller bytes reset to zero; six-byte data leaves a zero tail in this source model. These are compatibility facts, not retail calibration or encryption evidence.
